newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Heng Fung to place 150 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Heng Fung to place 150 mln new shares.

text.p: Property concern Heng Fung Holdings Co Ltd said on Monday it would privately place 150 million new shares, or 23.18 percent of the company's enlarged share capital, to independent investors at HK$0.58 each.
Heng Fung said Cheerful Securities was the placing agent.

Net proceeds of HK$83.50 million would be used to reduce bank borrowings and to fund expansion plans, including establishment of a securities dealing, securities advisory and corporate finance operation in the United States, it said.

On completion of the placement, shareholding of its executive director Ng Mok Yuen would be diluted to 14.64 percent from 19.06, and stake of its chairman Chan Heng Fai and his wife Chan Yoke Keow would be reduced to 11.29 percent from 14.70.

Meanwhile, Heng Fung said its private placement of 77.60 million new shares at HK$0.50 each to independent investors in January had been completed and the net proceeds of HK$37.80 million would be used to fund construction of a development property in Hunghom in Kowloon.
Heng Fung shares fell HK$0.01 to HK$0.61 in late Monday morning.
